app.name: FlibustaHub
app.tagline: A local catalog of your book library

home.title: Welcome
home.lead: Choose the folder with your books and import the catalog. Language and theme can be changed at any time.

interface.title: Interface
interface.effectsHint: On Linux the reduced mode replaces blur with a solid overlay.

errors.internal: An internal error occurred. Details were written to the log.
errors.config_unreadable: Could not read the settings file. Default values are in use.
errors.invalid_locale: This interface language is not supported.
errors.http_port_in_use: Port {port} is already in use. The local server did not start; the rest of the app still works.
errors.db_open_failed: Could not open the book catalog. Details were written to the log.
errors.db_migrate_failed: Could not update the catalog schema. A migration file may have been edited after it was applied.
errors.db_backup_failed: Could not create a catalog backup.
errors.import_cancelled: Import was cancelled. The catalog is unchanged.
errors.import_failed: Could not import the catalog. Details were written to the log.
errors.inpx_not_found: No .inpx catalog file was found in this folder. Choose the library root that contains the dump.

startup.title: The app could not open its data
startup.lead: The window is open, but the catalog is unavailable. You can retry or open the log and data folders.

import.title: Library catalog
import.emptyTitle: Books folder is not set yet
import.emptyBody: Choose the library root — the folder that contains the archives and the catalog file.
import.cancelBody: The import has not been saved yet. The catalog will stay as it was.
import.cancelDisabled: The data is already saved. The search index is being built, so cancel will not roll the catalog back.
import.confirmBody: The catalog will be updated from this dump. Personal ratings and notes will not change. The interface will be unavailable for about a minute.
import.confirmSameVersion: This dump is already imported. Running it again will not change anything.
import.closeBeforeBody: The import has not been saved yet. Closing the window will leave the catalog as it was.
import.closeAfterTitle: Close while the index is building?
import.closeAfterBody: The data is already in the catalog. Index building will stop and resume the next time the app starts.
import.missingOk: Every archive listed in the dump is present in the library folder.
import.missingCount: {n} archive listed in the dump is missing from the folder | {n} archives listed in the dump are missing from the folder
import.missingHint: Records from those archives are still in the catalog. Files cannot be downloaded until the archives appear on disk.
import.unnamedTitle: Genre codes without a dictionary name
import.unnamedCount: {n} code is shown as-is | {n} codes are shown as-is
import.unnamedOk: Every genre that was seen has a name.
import.mappedCount: {n} value was replaced | {n} values were replaced
import.encodingsMixed: Mixed dump: some files were read as UTF-8 and some as CP1251.
import.lastNone: No import has been run yet.
